messages:
elaine: Quick ask — can we get a one-page 'lightning sheet' for enterprise field that summarizes security + SLA + deploy options, includes a tight benchmark blurb, and a recommended inbound routing snippet?

sam: Yes. I sketched an outline: 1) elevator paragraph, 2) security highlights (KMS, VPC, audit logs), 3) SLA tiers + what they buy, 4) deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private) with one-line pros, 5) 3 benchmark callouts, 6) 2 CTAs + routing snippet.

devin: Need the routing snippet to include lead scoring fields for AE handoff. Suggest: `tags: enterprise, security, sla, vpc` and score > 75 -> sales-qualify. Also include email subject templates for inbound.

mike: For the security bullets please add: optional HSM integration, customer KMS key rotation, and audit log retention policy (90/365 days notes). For dedicated mention reserved GPU pools + burst policy.

tara: I can run a quick A/B on two headlines for the sheet: A) "Predictable inference for regulated apps" B) "Enterprise-grade inference: secure, fast, economical" — we should pick one for the webinar landing page too.

sam: Benchmark blurb (draft): "Real-world gen workload: p50=28ms, p95=72ms, p99=140ms on ded. capacity; median per-token cost reduced 45% vs naive single-request serving after batching + prefix cache." Use conservative numbers.

elaine: Love it. Can we get a 120-word blurb for marketing that ties security + SLA to lower ops risk? Also need a single-sentence sales-facing summary for AE to copy-paste.

mike: Draft blurb: "Redwood Inference gives teams predictable inference SLAs with optional private deployments and encryption-in-flight and at-rest. Built-in caching and batching cut per-token costs while preserving latency SLOs, letting security-conscious teams meet compliance without sacrificing performance."

devin: Sales one-liner: "Secure, SLA-backed inference for regulated apps — pin models, control keys, and route high-value traffic to dedicated pools."

tara: Webinar tie-in idea: 20-minute benchmark walkthrough + 10-minute customer Q&A. Title suggestion: "Serving LLMs in Regulated Environments: SLOs, Security, and Cost" — use the winner headline from the A/B.

elaine: Routing snippet for inbound automation (example):
```
if lead.industry == "healthcare" or lead.tags contains "regulated":
  assign.team = "enterprise-sales"
  add.tags = ["enterprise","security"]
  lead.score += 30
elif lead.company_size > 1000 and lead.expected_monthly_tokens > 1e7:
  assign.team = "dedicated-sales"
  add.tags = ["dedicated","high-volume"]
```

devin: Perfect — include also a webhook example for demo requests: `POST /leadhook` with body fields `model_use_case`, `compliance_needs`, `expected_tps`.

deploy-bot: draft-uploaded: https://drive.company/redwood/marketing/lightning-sheet-v1 (permissions: marketing-read) :white_check_mark:

elaine: I'll pull that into the design brief and share a Figma draft by EOD. Can someone own final copy + benchmark verification?

sam: I'll validate the benchmark numbers with infra and lock the copy.

mike: I'll add the exact SLA language (uptime, p99 latency targets) and confirm KMS/HSM copy.

elaine: Great. After copy lock, tar a webinar slot (tentatively 2 weeks) and we'll route registrants via the snippet. Thanks team :rocket:
